page.overview:
Who is Bottle Top Flies?

The Bottle Top Flies are minor characters in A Bug's Life.

"Inside a rusty can, Bennett's Bar is where the action is hopping. Some flies hang out by a bottle-top table, clinging to the side of the can. "Hey waiter, I'm in my food," one of them jokes. Is he a little buzzed already."
